import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
expected=r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'
print('FILE='+bpy.data.filepath)
print('EXPECTED='+str(bpy.data.filepath.lower()==expected.lower()))
print('DATUM='+str(bpy.context.scene.get('world_vertical_datum','NONE')))
e=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
low=bpy.data.collections.get('D | ESTACAO CIDADE BAIXA | blockout v1')
def zmin(o): return min((o.matrix_world@Vector(c)).z for c in o.bound_box)
h=next((o for o in e.all_objects if 'hall piso terreo' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None) if e else None
f=next((o for o in low.objects if 'piso saguão' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None) if low else None
t=next((o for o in e.all_objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None) if e else None
print('HALL_ZMIN='+str(round(zmin(h),3) if h else None))
print('LOW_ZMIN='+str(round(zmin(f),3) if f else None))
print('TOWER_ZMIN='+str(round(zmin(t),3) if t else None))
print('CONFIRM_RESTORE_OK')
